name: trilly_pf_v2
status: OFFLINE-OOT candidate — PAPER-TRADE is the arbiter. Strongest offline trilly config to date (policy-aware reg label + top-10%, 18/18 OOT days, placebo-clean, fillability-checked). offline≠live has burned this project — ramp from $25 on the live read.
purpose: post-grad pump-selection (policy-aware regression label) + trailing exit for solanatrilly graduated-token entries
changes_vs_v1: LABEL = L1 REGRESSION on realized trail-PnL @ $25 (what the exit ACTUALLY banks), rank by predicted $ — was binary demand proxy (cum_0>=100 SOL). Closes the train/serve objective gap. L1 (not L2) — outlier-robust on the tail-carried lane (plain L2 hurts).

OPERATING POINT top-10% (unchanged from v1 nominal, but now profitable to reopen): recall ~doubles 0.11->0.19, $100 +515->+726/day. v1's effective lead had drifted to top-5%; reg label makes top-10% the win.

FEATURES = locked6 + enrich7 (13) — added 7 non-leaky pre-grad-curve feats (late-demand/conviction/concentration + price-path). Were marginal under the demand label, LOAD-BEARING under the policy label.
EXIT = T1800/trail25/SL25 (was T1200). Co-tune confirmed near-optimal; 1800 a sliver better than 1200. Wider trail / longer timer / tighter SL all WORSE.
WALLET/reputation/holder/cluster features = NO-GO (4 causal constructions, all wash/hurt; redundant with curve flow). Explicitly NOT in the feature set. See WALLET_FEATURES_FINDINGS.md.

feature_vector.source: build_universe.py — all leak-free at the graduation instant (gts), from the pre-grad curve t<=gts

defs.f_value: net_flow_sol = Σ buy SOL − Σ sell SOL over pre-grad swaps
defs.f_momentum: buyer_accel = uniq buyers in 2nd half of [first_swap,gts] / (uniq buyers 1st half + 1)
defs.f_size: log1p(total SOL transacted on the curve)
defs.f_holders: net_holders = # wallets with Σ(buy tokens) > Σ(sell tokens) by gts
defs.f_top1: top-1 buyer SOL / total buy SOL
defs.new_buyers_last60: # buyers whose first buy is within 60s before gts (late fresh demand)
defs.new_buyers_last300: # buyers whose first buy is within 300s before gts
defs.diamond_frac: fraction of buyers who never sold pre-grad (conviction)
defs.price_ret: entry_quote/first_px − 1 over the curve (CONTINUATION — known live-inverter, watch live)
defs.price_maxrun: max(px)/first_px − 1 over the curve (CONTINUATION — known live-inverter, watch live)

feature_vector.note: pure pre-grad-curve, live-compliant, NO reputation-bank dependency

selection_model.target: p25_1800_25_25 = realized trail-PnL in $ at $25 sizing under the locked exit (honest split-impact)
selection_model.train_window: ALL days (ship); OOT evidence from first 70% train / last 18 days test

exit_policy.type: trailing stop + hard stop-loss (sell INTO liquidity, no take-profit)
exit_policy.rule: sell at first of: price<=peak*(1-0.25) after 15s; OR price<=fill*(1-0.25); OR 1800s
exit_policy.settle: honest split-impact: entry-half×exit-half S/(S+flow), 1% fee, drain-VWAP over [t,t+30s]

entry.honest_fill: first post-grad swap at t>=gts+2s within 30s; reject if slip>15% vs at-grad quote or dust (<0.3x local median); else NOT enterable (skip)

gate.live_threshold_note: predicted-$ cutoff (median of per-day 90th pct). Per-token live can't rank a full day; start here and RECALIBRATE on the live predicted-$ distribution to hold ~10%/day.

sizing.ramp: START $25; ramp to $100 ONLY on live read while logging deep-book fill quality (impact-fragile past $100).

offline_performance.basis: OOT 18 days, honest split-impact fills, tape-graded, mean of 3 seeds; placebo (shuffled label) top-10% = -$64/day, win 27% -> signal real

caveats: OFFLINE-OOT only; placebo-clean & seed-robust & fillability-checked (exits into $6-8k flow) but the PAPER read is the decider.
price_ret/price_maxrun are CONTINUATION/momentum = this project's recurring live-inverter; CIlo>0 + seed-robust necessary NOT sufficient.
label/fills are Birdeye post-grad tapes + modeled split-impact + recent fold; real fills/latency/impact differ, esp. toward $100.
lane structurally decays — retrain frequently; the recent fold is the only valid read.
